acceptanceCriteria: Decide whether renew MUST refuse a non-current generation; record the rule in the Tasks spec with a requirement ID
Add a test: claim, release, re-claim, renew with the superseded generation is refused with a named code and leaves the live lease unchanged
If the current behavior is intended, document it and close this as not a bug with the receipt evidence
body: Observed 2026-10-12 with corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.456 on queue:corvint:main, attempt attempt:corvint:main:7f493eb294ec2725acb1a2f6f52e47b2 (V1-1305). Sequence: release at generation 363 (outcome OK), claim V1-1305 again (same attempt id, generation 370), submit and gate run at 370. An orchestrator loop that still held generation 363 then ran renew --generation 363 --lease-minutes 180 at 19:07:22Z and 19:17:25Z; both returned top-level outcome OK and echoed items[0].generation 363, while attempt show reported generation 370 phase CHECKING. Log lines: 2026-10-12T19:17:25Z lane=1305 gen_in=363 gen_out=363 outcome=OK 2026-10-12T19:17:25Z lane=1305 heartbeat=OK . Expected: renew with a generation that is not the attempt current generation is refused (STALE or GENERATION_MISMATCH style code), as submit/complete already refuse stale trees. Actual: OK with the stale generation echoed; it is unknown whether the lease of generation 370 was extended, left alone, or a stale record was revived. Raw renew responses were not retained by the loop (only outcome and generation); reproduction: claim, release, re-claim, then renew with the first generation. Related: V1-1313 (renew leaves lastHeartbeatAt stale). Suspected defect, not confirmed; confirm by reading the receipt journal for the two renew request ids renew-1305-1791832842 and renew-1305-1791833445 if present.
title: Suspected: corvint-tasks renew accepts a superseded generation (renew --generation 363 returned OK while the attempt was re-claimed at generation 370)
